output.summary: A palm native to northern and western Africa, the Levant and Arabian Peninsula. Its trunk forks into branches topped by fan-shaped leaves, while female trees bear woody, single-seeded fruits that remain on the tree for long periods.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit rind and pulp, unripe kernels, germinated seed shoots, young-fruit juice and sap are consumed in foods, drinks and palm wine.
